function_fingerprints: select n.nspname as schema_name, p.proname as function_name, pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as identity_arguments, p.pronargs as argument_count, l.lanname as language, p.prosecdef as security_definer, p.proconfig as configuration, md5(replace(p.prosrc,chr(13),'')) as body_md5 from pg_catalog.pg_proc p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_catalog.pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang where n.nspname in ('public','private') and p.proname in ('permission_financial_checkpoint','permission_financial_allowed','get_write_capabilities','register_write_operation','execute_write_operation','write_operation_request','get_write_operation','cancel_write_operation','list_write_operations','lock_write_input','prepare_write','apply_write','operation_view','permission_current_employee','permission_identity_lock','permission_start_session','permission_revoke_session','permission_check_required_pin_session','permission_complete_required_pin_change','permission_get_authority','permission_get_revision','permission_read_guard','permission_get_floor_operational','permission_get_open_order_detail','emit_store_change_signal','emit_permission_catalog_signal','permission_create_initial_receipt_print_grant') order by 1,2,3;
publication: select pubname,schemaname,tablename from pg_catalog.pg_publication_tables where pubname='supabase_realtime' order by 1,2,3;
signal_triggers: select n.nspname as schema_name,c.relname as table_name,t.tgname as trigger_name,t.tgenabled as enabled_mode,pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) as definition from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and (t.tgname like 'permission_signal_%' or c.relname='permission_catalog_state') and not t.tgisinternal order by 1,2,3;
